description: Load vet pack — authority + BASICs + broker + OFAC name. One call before you tender: FMCSA authority, SMS BASICs and broker status for a USDOT and/or MC number, plus an OFAC name screen when you pass a legal name. Verdict is TENDER, HOLD or REJECT from those public fields only — no invented fraud score. Cites FMCSA QCMobile and OFAC as_of. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
